articles.title_en: Analyzing the impact of low-carbon city pilot policy on enterprises' labor demand: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 低碳城市试点政策对企业劳动力需求的影响分析：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Low-carbon city pilot policies (LCCPPs) are a crucial initiative to fulfill “peak carbon dioxide emissions” and “carbon neutrality”, which may also have prominent impacts on employment and economic development. We exploit the implementation of China's LCCPPs as an exogenous policy shock and employ a difference-in-differences (DID) model to investigate how LCCPPs affect enterprises' labor demand and their mechanisms. We observe that LCCPPs significantly increase enterprises' labor demand in pilot regions. After employing the instrumental variable approach to mitigate endogeneity problems, the results still hold. The mechanism analysis reveals that the implementation of LCCPPs enhances enterprises' labor demand by guiding or forcing enterprises to engage in front-end environment governance (changes in the production process). Specifically, this policy guides enterprises to develop innovative products and technologies that are beneficial to the environment, which not only directly stimulates the demand for technical personnel, but also boosts firm productivity and profits, thereby triggering the demand for personnel in the non-technical sector. Heterogeneity results show that LCCPPs significantly spur the labor demand of high-carbon emitting enterprises and low financing constraint enterprises. Furthermore, LCCPPs play a prominent role in stimulating the labor demand of enterprises in non-resource-based cities or cities with stringent environmental law enforcement. Our findings provide empirical support for other countries to drive the transformation of their economic system to low-carbon and green growth.
articles.abstract_cn: 低碳城市试点政策是实现“碳达峰”和“碳中和”的重要举措，也可能对就业和经济发展产生显著影响。我们利用中国低碳城市试点政策的实施作为外生政策冲击，采用双重差分模型研究低碳城市试点政策如何影响企业劳动力需求及其作用机制。我们观察到，低碳城市试点政策显著增加了试点地区企业的劳动力需求。在采用工具变量法缓解内生性问题后，结果依然成立。机制分析表明，低碳城市试点政策的实施通过引导或迫使企业进行前端环境治理（生产过程的改变）来增强企业的劳动力需求。具体而言，该政策引导企业开发有益于环境的创新产品和技术，这不仅直接刺激了对技术人员的需求，还提高了企业生产率和利润，从而引发了对非技术部门人员的需求。异质性结果显示，低碳城市试点政策显著刺激了高碳排放企业和低融资约束企业的劳动力需求。此外，低碳城市试点政策在非资源型城市或环境执法严格的城市中，对刺激企业劳动力需求作用显著。我们的研究结果为其他国家推动经济体系向低碳和绿色增长转型提供了实证支持。

articles.title_en: Oil uncertainty and the price-cost markup: Evidence from U.S. data
articles.title_cn: 石油不确定性与价格成本加成：来自美国数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the implications of uncertainty in the oil and gas sector for the dynamics of the price-cost markup at the business cycle frequency. We estimate a structural VAR model using U.S. quarterly data for the period 1982q2:2018q4, and find that an increase in oil uncertainty reduces the measured price-cost markup and economic activities. This result is consistent with the prediction of a calibrated New-Keynesian model with oil uncertainty shocks. These findings also provide insights into the relevance of the markup as a transmission channel of oil uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了石油和天然气行业不确定性对商业周期频率下价格成本加成动态的影响。我们使用1982q2:2018q4期间的美国季度数据估计了一个结构VAR模型，发现石油不确定性的增加会降低测得的价格成本加成和经济活动。这一结果与包含石油不确定性冲击的校准新凯恩斯模型的预测一致。这些发现也为加成作为石油不确定性传导渠道的相关性提供了见解。

articles.title_en: The role of fundamentals and policy in New Zealand's carbon prices
articles.title_cn: 基本面与政策在新西兰碳价格中的作用
articles.abstract_en: The New Zealand Emission Trading Scheme (NZ ETS) is unique in that it includes forestry as a carbon sink (a source of unit supply). Further, the NZ ETS has been subject to many policy changes including a switch from allowing unlimited importation of units to becoming completely autarkic. In this context, we analyse the pricing dynamics for New Zealand Units (NZUs) driven by the interaction between allowances supply and demand between 2010 and 2019 and for two sets of subperiods divided by the official and actual de-link dates. Our empirical models find that international offsets negatively affected NZU returns before the actual de-link date, domestic supply after the official de-link date, and banked units between the official and actual de-link dates, and that green (mainly forestry) offsets, surprisingly, positively affected NZU returns before the actual de-link date. Our results also highlight that from a demand perspective, sectoral effects had significant relationships with NZU returns with different dynamics. Namely, manufacturing and construction activities shifted to negatively affect NZU returns after the official de-link date, implying that fixed allocative baselines have resulted in over-allocation over time. Stationary energy sector activities shifted from negatively to positively affecting NZU returns after the official de-link date probably due to their exploitation of unlimited international offset during the linking period.
articles.abstract_cn: 新西兰排放交易计划（NZ ETS）的独特之处在于它将林业作为碳汇（单位供应来源）纳入其中。此外，NZ ETS经历了多次政策变化，包括从允许无限进口单位转变为完全自给自足。在此背景下，我们分析了由配额供需相互作用驱动的新西兰单位（NZU）定价动态，时间跨度为2010年至2019年，并分为由官方和实际脱钩日期划分的两组子时期。我们的实证模型发现，国际抵消在实际脱钩日期前对NZU回报产生负面影响，国内供应在官方脱钩日期后产生负面影响，银行单位在官方和实际脱钩日期之间产生负面影响，而绿色（主要是林业）抵消，令人惊讶地，在实际脱钩日期前对NZU回报产生正面影响。我们的结果还强调，从需求角度看，部门效应与NZU回报存在显著关系，且动态不同。即，制造业和建筑业活动在官方脱钩日期后转为对NZU回报产生负面影响，表明固定分配基准随时间导致了过度分配。固定能源部门活动在官方脱钩日期后从对NZU回报的负面影响转为正面影响，可能是由于它们在连接期间利用了无限的国际抵消。

articles.title_en: Modeling stock-oil co-dependence with Dynamic Stochastic MIDAS Copula models
articles.title_cn: 基于动态随机MIDAS Copula模型的股票-石油相依性建模
articles.abstract_en: Stock and oil relationship is usually time-varying and depends on the current economic conditions. In this study, we propose a new Dynamic Stochastic Mixed data sampling (DSM) copula model, that decomposes the stock-oil relationship into a short-run dynamic stochastic component and a long-run component, governed by related macro-finance variables. Inference and prediction is carried out using a novel Bayesian estimation strategy, that can efficiently estimate the latent states and delivers an estimate of the log marginal likelihood used for model comparison. We find that inflation/interest rate, uncertainty and liquidity factors are the main drivers of the long-run co-dependence. We show that the multi-step-ahead variance covariance forecasts constructed using the proposed approach are closer to the true values as compared to the benchmark model. Finally, investment portfolios, based on the proposed DSM copula model, are more accurate and produce better economic outcomes as compared to other alternatives.
articles.abstract_cn: 股票与石油的关系通常是时变的，并取决于当前的经济状况。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新的动态随机混合数据抽样（DSM）copula模型，该模型将股票-石油关系分解为短期动态随机成分和长期成分，长期成分由相关的宏观金融变量驱动。推断和预测采用一种新颖的贝叶斯估计策略进行，该策略能够有效估计潜在状态，并提供用于模型比较的对数边际似然估计。我们发现通胀/利率、不确定性和流动性因素是长期共同依赖的主要驱动因素。我们表明，使用所提出的方法构建的多步超前方差协方差预测比基准模型更接近真实值。最后，基于所提出的DSM copula模型的投资组合与其他替代方案相比更准确，并产生更好的经济结果。

articles.title_en: Potential gains of long-distance trade in electricity
articles.title_cn: 远距离电力贸易的潜在收益
articles.abstract_en: Electrification of all economic sectors and solar photovoltaics (PV) becoming the lowest-cost electricity generation technology in ever more regions give rise to new potential gains of trade. We develop a stylized analytical model to minimize unit energy cost in autarky, open it to different trade configurations, and evaluate it empirically. We identify large potential gains from interhemispheric and global electricity trade by combining complementary seasonal and diurnal cycles. The corresponding high willingness to pay for large-scale transmission suggests far-reaching political economy and regulatory implications.
articles.abstract_cn: 所有经济部门的电气化以及太阳能光伏（PV）在越来越多地区成为最低成本的发电技术，带来了新的贸易潜在收益。我们开发了一个简化的分析模型，以最小化自给自足状态下的单位能源成本，将其开放给不同的贸易配置，并进行实证评估。我们发现，通过结合互补的季节性和昼夜周期，半球间和全球电力贸易存在巨大的潜在收益。相应的大规模输电高支付意愿暗示了深远的政治经济学和监管影响。

articles.title_en: Does new-type urbanization policy promote green energy efficiency? Evidence from a quasi-natural experiment in China
articles.title_cn: 新型城镇化政策是否促进了绿色能源效率？来自中国准自然实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Although economy-centered urbanization has been favored by many developing countries, it has brought about serious economic and social challenges while creating an economic miracle. To achieve sustainable development and address the issue of excessive energy consumption caused by traditional urbanization, China began to implement the new-type people-centered urbanization policy since 2014. This paper is the first to theoretically analyze the mechanism and impact of new-type urbanization policy (NUP) on green energy efficiency (GEE). By using the panel data of 285 Chinese cities during 2003–2017, after measuring GEE considering environmental constraints, this paper examines the impact and its mechanism of NUP on GEE. The results show that in comparison to non-pilot cities, the implementation of NUP could prevent GEE from improving, and lower GEE by 0.060 on average. After a series of tests, the main conclusion remains robust. Mechanism analysis indicates that NUP can affect GEE through green technical efficiency and green technological progress. Heterogeneity analysis suggests that under the constraints of different urban industries, resource endowment, city size, economic development stage, and urban administrative level, NUP has diverse impacts on GEE. Corresponding policy implications are proposed accordingly to improve GEE.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管以经济为中心的城镇化受到许多发展中国家的青睐，但它在创造经济奇迹的同时也带来了严重的经济和社会挑战。为了实现可持续发展并解决传统城镇化导致的能源过度消耗问题，中国自2014年开始实施以人为中心的新型城镇化政策。本文首次从理论上分析了新型城镇化政策（NUP）对绿色能源效率（GEE）的影响及其机制。通过使用285-2003年间中国2017个城市的面板数据，在考虑环境约束测算GEE后，本文检验了NUP对GEE的影响及其机制。结果表明，与非试点城市相比，NUP的实施会阻碍GEE的提升，平均降低GEE0.0.060。经过一系列检验后，主要结论依然稳健。机制分析表明，NUP可以通过绿色技术效率和绿色技术进步影响GEE。异质性分析表明，在不同城市产业、资源禀赋、城市规模、经济发展阶段和城市行政级别的约束下，NUP对GEE的影响存在差异。据此提出了相应的政策建议以提升GEE。

articles.title_en: How to purchase carbon emission right optimally for energy-consuming enterprises? Analysis based on optimal stopping model
articles.title_cn: 能源消耗型企业如何最优购买碳排放权？基于最优停止模型的分析
articles.abstract_en: Enterprises with a schedule of purchasing carbon emission rights might face great fluctuations in the price dynamic of carbon assets, thus need to seek the proper timing to establish their long position. However, carbon asset management is not simply a timing optimization of buying financial assets; it is always in line with the prediction of consumption, inventory, and demand of carbon emission rights. This paper models the decision-making of buying carbon emission rights based on an optimal stopping problem constructed in a Brownian environment. To solve this optimal stopping problem, a virtual terminal point technique is developed to obtain a closed-form expression of the stopping boundary. The application of this technique in practice is simulated by a case study. This paper contributes in the following aspects: (1) Theoretically, it integrates research on enterprise carbon asset operation management and investment in the carbon financial markets. (2) Practically, it provides a quantitative decision-making scheme for enterprises buying carbon emission rights. (3) Technically, it pioneers a new method of solving the optimal stopping problem which was previously unsolvable for closed-form solutions.
articles.abstract_cn: 有购买碳排放权计划的企业可能面临碳资产价格动态的巨大波动，因此需要寻求建立多头头寸的合适时机。然而，碳资产管理不仅仅是购买金融资产的时机优化问题；它始终与碳排放权的消耗、库存和需求的预测相一致。本文基于在布朗环境中构建的最优停止问题，对购买碳排放权的决策进行建模。为了解决这个最优停止问题，开发了一种虚拟终点技术，以获得停止边界的闭式表达式。通过案例研究模拟了该技术在实践中的应用。本文的贡献如下：（1）理论上，整合了企业碳资产运营管理和碳金融市场投资的研究。（2）实践上，为购买碳排放权的企业提供了定量决策方案。（3）技术上，开创了一种解决最优停止问题的新方法，该方法以前无法获得闭式解。

articles.title_en: Price connectedness in U.S. ethanol terminal markets
articles.title_cn: 美国乙醇终端市场的价格关联性
articles.abstract_en: This article shows, for the first time, the degree of price volatility connectedness across the major regional ethanol markets in the U.S. Connectedness measures are based on forecast error variance decompositions that inform which prices drive system dynamics. We pay special attention to volatility spillovers to and from Chicago, as it is equipped with one of the largest terminals in the U.S. and is widely regarded as the center of ethanol price discovery in the country. Ethanol prices in the Chicago terminal electronic trading platform are also suspected of being manipulated over the 2017‐2019 period. We use Diebold and Yilmaz (2012 and 2014) and a rolling window approach to study the dynamics of price volatility connectedness over time. Using daily data from 2013 to the beginning of 2021, we find that Chicago is the market that generates the most innovations to other market prices. In contrast, Chicago receives the least amount of innovations from all other markets, placing Chicago at the center of price dynamics. We find that price connectedness measures are correlated with market fundamentals, policy, and concentration in the Chicago terminal electronic trading platform, with the latter being associated to an increase in the relevance of Chicago as a central market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文首次展示了美国主要区域乙醇市场之间价格波动关联性的程度。关联性度量基于预测误差方差分解，这些分解揭示了哪些价格驱动系统动态。我们特别关注芝加哥的波动溢出效应，因为芝加哥拥有美国最大的终端之一，并被广泛认为是该国乙醇价格发现的中心。芝加哥终端电子交易平台上的乙醇价格在2017年至2019年期间也被怀疑受到操纵。我们使用Diebold和Yilmaz（2012年和2014年）的方法以及滚动窗口方法来研究价格波动关联性随时间的变化。使用2013年至2021年初的日度数据，我们发现芝加哥是产生对其他市场价格最多创新的市场。相反，芝加哥从所有其他市场接收的创新最少，使芝加哥处于价格动态的中心。我们发现价格关联性度量与市场基本面、政策以及芝加哥终端电子交易平台的集中度相关，后者与芝加哥作为中心市场相关性的增加有关。

articles.title_en: Exchange rate pass-through and inflation targeting regime under energy price shocks
articles.title_cn: 能源价格冲击下的汇率传递与通胀目标制
articles.abstract_en: The global surge in energy costs poses a significant obstacle for the attainment of price stability by the central banks across the world. This obstacle is further magnified for the economies that adopt an inflation-targeting framework and a flexible exchange rate regime. To overcome this challenge, our study attempts to answer whether inflation targeting can achieve price stability if an exchange rate pass-through exists, especially in the presence of energy price shocks. The study uses secondary data from twenty-one inflation-targeting economies for the period 1997-2020 and applies the non-linear autoregressive distributive lag (NARDL) model to test the hypotheses empirically, considering the possible asymmetries. The results confirm that exchange rate depreciation increases domestic price levels, while exchange rate appreciation reduces them in the long run. The study also finds that rising energy prices contribute to higher inflation in inflation-targeting economies. These findings suggest that inflation-targeting economies face a serious challenge in maintaining their core price stability goal due to exchange rate pass-through especially during energy price shocks. The results invite authorities of IT economies to re-evaluate their policy framework that conveniently ignores exchange rate pass-through by requiring a mandatory floating exchange rate regime.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球能源成本飙升对世界各国央行实现价格稳定构成了重大障碍。对于采用通胀目标制框架和浮动汇率制度的经济体而言，这一障碍更为突出。为克服这一挑战，本研究试图回答在存在汇率传递的情况下，尤其是在能源价格冲击下，通胀目标制能否实现价格稳定。研究使用了1997-2020年间二十一个通胀目标制经济体的二手数据，并应用非线性自回归分布滞后（NARDL）模型，考虑可能的不对称性，对假设进行实证检验。结果证实，长期内汇率贬值会提高国内价格水平，而汇率升值则会降低国内价格水平。研究还发现，能源价格上涨会加剧通胀目标制经济体的通胀。这些发现表明，由于汇率传递的存在，尤其是在能源价格冲击期间，通胀目标制经济体在维持其核心价格稳定目标方面面临严峻挑战。结果提请通胀目标制经济体的当局重新评估其政策框架，该框架通过要求强制浮动汇率制度而忽视了汇率传递。

articles.title_en: How manufacturing firms respond to energy subsidy reforms? An impact assessment of the Iranian Energy Subsidy Reform
articles.title_cn: 制造业企业如何应对能源补贴改革？伊朗能源补贴改革的影响评估
articles.abstract_en: Energy prices increased several folds due to the 2010 Iranian Energy Subsidy Reform. This study assesses the impact of the reform on the performance of the manufacturing sector using a detailed micro-panel dataset at the 4-digit ISIC level for the period 2009 to 2013. Since the reform universally affected all firms, the analysis relies on a quasi-experimental framework implementing first an explorative before-after design with structural fixed-effects and second a difference-in-difference analysis exploiting the energy-sensitivity of the studied firm-groups. The subsidy reform reduced output and value-added by 3 and 7%, respectively. Profits decreased by nearly 9%. Heterogeneity analyses show that the manufacturing sector has been affected through three channels: increasing costs of direct energy inputs, pass-through costs for inputs from upstream firms and an energy-price-induced demand contraction. We conclude that for successfully implementing an energy subsidy reform while maintaining growth in the manufacturing sector, direct and indirect costs have to be considered. Importantly, the results can inform expected energy reforms to mitigate climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 由于2010年伊朗能源补贴改革，能源价格数倍上涨。本研究利用4年至2009年期间2013位数ISIC级别的详细微观面板数据集，评估了该改革对制造业部门绩效的影响。由于改革普遍影响了所有企业，分析依赖于准实验框架，首先实施具有结构固定效应的探索性前后设计，其次利用所研究企业组的能源敏感性进行双重差分分析。补贴改革使产出和增加值分别减少了3和7%。利润下降了近9%。异质性分析表明，制造业部门通过三个渠道受到影响：直接能源投入成本增加、上游企业投入品的转嫁成本以及能源价格引起的需求收缩。我们得出结论，为了在保持制造业增长的同时成功实施能源补贴改革，必须考虑直接和间接成本。重要的是，这些结果可以为预期的缓解气候变化的能源改革提供信息。

articles.title_en: Managerial performance and oil price shocks
articles.title_cn: 管理绩效与油价冲击
articles.abstract_en: Using an innovative method that segregates oil shocks into supply, consumption demand, and inventory demand factors, we find empirical evidence that managerial ability can have a significant but varying influence on firm performance under these circumstances. Generally, high-ability managers are most beneficial to manufacturing firms during oil shocks. In the event of oil supply shocks that are associated with negative economic implications, talented managers strongly outperform in (i) energy, (ii) agriculture, forestry, & fishing, and (iii) services industries. However, during oil demand consumption shocks that are symbolic of economic growth, competent managers underperform in the (a) energy, (b) mining, (c) construction, (d) retail, and (e) services sectors. Notably, high-ability managers in energy firms are associated with significant outperformance and underperformance during oil supply and consumption shocks, respectively. It is probable that these adept managers employ more active hedging programs to reduce financial distress or minimize earnings volatility to safeguard against oil price downturns. Similarly, in other industries, it is plausible that skillful managers may actively engage in oil price risk management (e.g., reducing reliance, alternatives, hedging, etc.). During supply shocks, the associated benefits outweigh the costs, and vice versa during oil consumption demand shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 采用一种创新方法将石油冲击分解为供给、消费需求和库存需求因素，我们发现了经验证据表明，在这些情况下，管理能力对企业绩效具有显著但不同的影响。总体而言，在石油冲击期间，高能力管理者对制造业企业最为有利。在与负面经济影响相关的石油供给冲击事件中，有才能的管理者在(i)能源、(ii)农业、林业和渔业以及(iii)服务业中表现突出。然而，在象征经济增长的石油需求消费冲击期间，能干的经理在(a)能源、(b)采矿、(c)建筑、(d)零售和(e)服务部门表现不佳。值得注意的是，能源企业中的高能力管理者在石油供给和消费冲击期间分别与显著的跑赢和跑输相关。这些熟练的管理者可能采用更积极的套期保值计划以减少财务困境或最小化盈利波动，从而防范油价下跌。同样，在其他行业，熟练的管理者可能积极参与油价风险管理（例如，减少依赖、替代品、套期保值等）。在供给冲击期间，相关收益超过成本，而在石油消费需求冲击期间则相反。

articles.title_en: The viability of energy efficiency in facilitating Saudi Arabia's journey toward net-zero emissions
articles.title_cn: 能源效率在促进沙特阿拉伯实现净零排放进程中的可行性
articles.abstract_en: Assessing the contribution of energy efficiency to climate change mitigation is crucial as global warming continues to persist. This study assesses the impact of energy efficiency on carbon intensity in Saudi Arabia and evaluates its potential contributions to the country's net-zero emissions target. We analyze time-series data for Saudi Arabia from 1971 to 2020 and estimate a quantile regression model. The results show that energy efficiency is critical for mitigating carbon dioxide emissions, indicating the importance of activating this lever to accelerate the decarbonization process. The model is robust to changes in the proxy for energy efficiency, confirming energy efficiency's ability to mitigate environmental degradation in Saudi Arabia. Moreover, energy efficiency has a greater impact on the twenty-fifth to seventy-fifth quantiles of carbon intensity than on the tenth and ninetieth quantiles. These heterogeneous effects across carbon intensity quantiles should be considered when the Saudi government discusses and sets its decarbonization objectives. We further extend the analysis by forecasting carbon intensity through 2060 under a scenario in which energy efficiency improves. The results show that energy efficiency improvements may account for up to one-fifth of Saudi Arabia's decarbonization by 2060. This finding underscores energy efficiency's importance for achieving climate stability and building a better future.
articles.abstract_cn: 评估能源效率对减缓气候变化的贡献至关重要，因为全球变暖持续存在。本研究评估了能源效率对沙特阿拉伯碳强度的影响，并评估了其对该国净零排放目标的潜在贡献。我们分析了沙特阿拉伯从1971年到2020年的时间序列数据，并估计了分位数回归模型。结果表明，能源效率对于减少二氧化碳排放至关重要，表明激活这一杠杆以加速脱碳进程的重要性。该模型对能源效率代理变量的变化具有稳健性，证实了能源效率在减轻沙特阿拉伯环境退化方面的能力。此外，能源效率对碳强度第二十五至第七十五分位数的影响大于对第十和第九十分位数的影响。当沙特政府讨论和设定其脱碳目标时，应考虑这些跨碳强度分位数的异质性效应。我们进一步扩展分析，在能源效率提高的情景下预测到2060年的碳强度。结果表明，能源效率的提高可能占沙特阿拉伯到2060年脱碳量的五分之一。这一发现强调了能源效率对于实现气候稳定和建设更美好未来的重要性。

articles.title_en: An empirical analysis of the dynamic relationship between clean and dirty energy markets
articles.title_cn: 清洁与肮脏能源市场动态关系的实证分析
articles.abstract_en: This research provides an empirical analysis of the dynamic relationship between clean and dirty energy markets. Specifically, we use Brent crude, West-Texas-Intermediate (WTI) crude, OPEC oil, Crude oil Oman and Crude Oil Dubai to denote dirty energy markets and use the S&P Global Clean Energy Index and WilderHill New Energy Global Innovation Index as a representative of the clean energy market. The time-frequency wavelet's multiple cross-correlation and cross-quantilogram correlation are used as estimation techniques to examine time-dependent wavelet cross-correlation and directional predictability, respectively. We use daily returns spanning from November 2013 to September 2020. Findings from the cross-quantilogram correlation (CQC) results suggest heterogeneous quantile dependence dynamics from clean energy markets to dirty energy markets. Additionally, findings from the cross-quantile correlation results reveal positive and negative directional predictability between clean and dirty energy markets in high, medium and low quantile ranges. Second, results from the time-frequency wavelets multiple cross-correlation approach suggest that clean and dirty energy markets are marginally integrated at the lowest frequencies, with dirty energy emerging as a predictive power of clean energy. In addition, we also find that the co-movements between the clean and dirty energy sources are volatile in the medium and long term, thus reducing the medium- and long-term diversification sphere. These findings are relevant for portfolio managers and clean energy producers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究对清洁与肮脏能源市场之间的动态关系进行了实证分析。具体而言，我们使用布伦特原油、西德克萨斯中质原油（WTI）、OPEC石油、阿曼原油和迪拜原油来代表肮脏能源市场，并使用标普全球清洁能源指数和WilderHill新能源全球创新指数作为清洁能源市场的代表。采用时频小波多重互相关和交叉分位数图相关作为估计技术，分别检验随时间变化的小波互相关和方向可预测性。我们使用从2013年十一月到2020年九月的日收益率。交叉分位数图相关（CQC）的结果表明，从清洁能源市场到肮脏能源市场存在异质的分位数依赖动态。此外，交叉分位数相关的结果揭示了在高、中、低分位数范围内，清洁与肮脏能源市场之间存在正向和负向的方向可预测性。其次，时频小波多重互相关方法的结果表明，清洁与肮脏能源市场在最低频率上边际整合，其中肮脏能源作为清洁能源的预测力量出现。此外，我们还发现清洁与肮脏能源来源之间的共同运动在中期和长期内波动较大，从而减少了中期和长期的多元化空间。这些发现对投资组合管理者和清洁能源生产商具有相关性。

articles.title_en: Emotional or rational choice: The influence of individual personality on energy-saving behavior
articles.title_cn: 情感还是理性选择：个体人格对节能行为的影响
articles.abstract_en: Exploring the formation mechanism of individual energy-saving behavior, especially from the perspective of individual micro characteristics, is important to alleviate energy shortage and achieve sustainable economic and social development. The impacts of individual emotional personality and rational personality on energy-saving behavior are analyzed by the hierarchical regression analysis, structural equation, and bootstrap method based on 543 samples in this study. The moderating effect of social environmental atmosphere in the relationship between these personalities and energy-saving behavior is considered. The results show that: (1) emotional personality and rational personality have a positive impact on individuals' energy-saving behavior, and emotional personality has a greater positive effect on energy-saving behavior than rational personality; (2) social environmental atmosphere can strengthen the positive effect of emotional personality on energy-saving behavior, but the moderating effect is not significant in the relationship between rational personality and energy-saving behavior. Based on the study findings, suggestions were put forward, so as to enhance the enthusiasm of public to implement energy-saving behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 探索个体节能行为的形成机制，特别是从个体微观特征的视角，对于缓解能源短缺和实现经济社会可持续发展具有重要意义。本研究基于543个样本，通过层次回归分析、结构方程和bootstrap方法，分析了个体情感人格和理性人格对节能行为的影响，并考虑了社会环境氛围在这些人格与节能行为关系中的调节作用。结果表明：(1)情感人格和理性人格对个体节能行为有正向影响，且情感人格对节能行为的正向影响大于理性人格；(2)社会环境氛围能够强化情感人格对节能行为的正向影响，但在理性人格与节能行为的关系中调节作用不显著。基于研究结果，提出了建议，以增强公众实施节能行为的积极性。

articles.title_en: The impact of producer services agglomeration on green economic development: Evidence from 278 Chinese cities
articles.title_cn: 生产性服务业集聚对绿色经济发展的影响：来自中国278个城市的证据
articles.abstract_en: Driven by market and government forces, China's producer services industries have shown a trend of agglomeration. However, whether this trend can further promote the development of a green economy remains to be explored. Using the panel data of 278 Chinese cities from 2004 to 2017, this study empirically investigates the impact of China's producer services agglomeration on green economic development and examines the moderating effects of relevant industrial and environmental regulation policies. The results show that: (1) Producer services agglomeration promotes China's green economic development, which is obtained by promoting industrial structure upgrading and green technology innovation. (2) The development zone upgrading policy and command-and-control carbon emissions reduction policy can strengthen the positive impact of producer services agglomeration on the green urban economy. (3) The carbon trading policy, as a market-based carbon reduction tool, does not affect the green economic effect of the producer services agglomeration during the sample period.
articles.abstract_cn: 在市场与政府力量的驱动下，中国生产性服务业呈现出集聚趋势。然而，这一趋势能否进一步促进绿色经济发展仍有待探讨。利用2004年至2017年中国278个城市的面板数据，本研究实证考察了中国生产性服务业集聚对绿色经济发展的影响，并检验了相关产业和环境规制政策的调节效应。结果表明：（1）生产性服务业集聚促进了中国绿色经济发展，这一促进作用通过推动产业结构升级和绿色技术创新实现。（2）开发区升级政策和命令控制型碳减排政策能够强化生产性服务业集聚对城市绿色经济的积极影响。（3）碳交易政策作为一种市场化的碳减排工具，在样本期内并未影响生产性服务业集聚的绿色经济效应。

articles.title_en: The impact of China's pilot carbon ETS on the labor income share: Based on an empirical method of combining PSM with staggered DID
articles.title_cn: 中国试点碳排放权交易对劳动收入份额的影响：基于PSM与交错DID相结合的实证方法
articles.abstract_en: The carbon emissions trading scheme (ETS), which restricts carbon emission permit allowances, affects firms' decisions on labor and capital use in production. Taking China's ETS as a quasi-natural experiment and using firm-level panel data from 2009 to 2019, this study evaluates the impact of China's pilot carbon ETS on the labor income share. We adopt the Propensity Score Matching combined with Staggered Difference-in-Differences method, allowing considerable treatment effect heterogeneity. The estimated results of the overall treatment effect show that China's pilot carbon ETS significantly increases the labor income share. When we consider the treatment effect heterogeneity across calendar time, entry cohort, and length of policy exposure, most coefficients remain significantly positive. These findings provide initial empirical evidence that climate policy may help reduce excessive dependence on capital and fossil energy, thereby alleviating the global trend of declining labor income share.
articles.abstract_cn: 碳排放权交易制度（ETS）限制了碳排放配额的许可，影响企业在生产中劳动力和资本使用的决策。以中国ETS为准自然实验，利用2009年至2019年的企业层面面板数据，本研究评估了中国试点碳排放权交易对劳动收入份额的影响。我们采用倾向得分匹配与交错双重差分相结合的方法，允许相当大的处理效应异质性。总体处理效应的估计结果显示，中国试点碳排放权交易显著提高了劳动收入份额。当我们考虑日历时间、进入队列和政策暴露长度上的处理效应异质性时，大多数系数仍然显著为正。这些发现提供了初步的经验证据，表明气候政策可能有助于减少对资本和化石能源的过度依赖，从而缓解全球劳动收入份额下降的趋势。

articles.title_en: Short- and long-run determinants of the price behavior of US clean energy stocks: A dynamic ARDL simulations approach
articles.title_cn: 美国清洁能源股票价格行为的短期和长期决定因素：动态ARDL模拟方法
articles.abstract_en: This paper aims to identify factors that drive US clean-energy stock price movements in the short and long term, using a wide range of variables representing the carbon emission market, non-green financial assets, non-renewable commodities, macroeconomic fundamentals, investor attention and sentiment, and global stress and uncertainty. The empirical investigation is carried out in the context of the elastic-net regularization (ENET) approach and dynamic simulations of the autoregressive distributed lag (DYNARDL) model, with proper consideration to the potential presence of structural changes. From among 26 candidate variables, the ENET selects the clean technology market, public attention to clean energy, oil, and gold as the primary factors contributing the most to the behavior of clean-energy stock prices. The estimation results of the DYNARDL model suggest that the clean technology market and oil are vital determinants in the short and long run, while public attention and gold tend to affect clean-energy stock prices only in the short run. Furthermore, the respective magnitudes of influence of the four variables are larger in the short term than in the long term. Our findings offer practical implications for socially responsible investors and policymakers.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文旨在利用代表碳排放市场、非绿色金融资产、非可再生商品、宏观经济基本面、投资者关注和情绪以及全球压力和不确定性的广泛变量，识别驱动美国清洁能源股票价格短期和长期变动的因素。实证研究在弹性网络正则化（ENET）方法和自回归分布滞后模型（DYNARDL）的动态模拟背景下进行，并适当考虑了结构性变化的潜在存在。从26个候选变量中，ENET选择清洁技术市场、公众对清洁能源的关注、石油和黄金作为对清洁能源股票价格行为贡献最大的主要因素。DYNARDL模型的估计结果表明，清洁技术市场和石油是短期和长期的重要决定因素，而公众关注和黄金往往仅在短期内影响清洁能源股票价格。此外，这四个变量各自的影响幅度在短期内大于长期。我们的发现为社会负责任投资者和政策制定者提供了实际启示。

articles.title_en: A pathway to sustainable development: Digitization and green productivity
articles.title_cn: 通往可持续发展的路径：数字化与绿色生产率
articles.abstract_en: Green productivity plays an important role in sustainable development, social energy conservation, and emission reduction targets. To investigate the impact of digital development on green total factor productivity, this research employs panel data of China's Yangtze River Delta from 2002 to 2020. First, this paper presents the super SBM method with unexpected output to comprehensively and systematically calculate the green total factor productivity (GTFP) index. Second, we use the partial linear function coefficient (PLFC) model, which can distinguish spatial-temporal heterogeneity, analyze how digital development improves GTFP, and evaluate the effect of human capital (HC) and industrial structure upgrading (IS) in this relationship. In addition, we conduct a comparative study between this delta region and other regions in China. The results of this paper are as follows. (1) Digitization has a significant and positive influence on GTFP for all samples. (2) HC and IS affect the role of digital development in promoting GTFP of cities in the Yangtze River Delta, but their impact is not significant in the three northeastern provinces. (3) The stimulation effect shows significant temporal and spatial heterogeneity under the influence of HC and IS. Provincial capitals and economically developed cities have the most prominent stimulating influence. Lastly, based on the non-parametric relevance between digital development and GTFP, this paper gives constructive and practical policy suggestions to improve GTFP and promote green economic development.
articles.abstract_cn: 绿色生产率在可持续发展、社会节能和减排目标中扮演着重要角色。为探究数字发展对绿色全要素生产率的影响，本研究采用中国长三角地区2002年至2020年的面板数据。首先，本文提出包含非期望产出的超效率SBM方法，全面系统地计算绿色全要素生产率（GTFP）指数。其次，我们使用能够区分时空异质性的部分线性函数系数（PLFC）模型，分析数字发展如何提升GTFP，并评估人力资本（HC）和产业结构升级（IS）在这一关系中的作用。此外，我们将该三角洲地区与中国其他地区进行对比研究。本文的结果如下：（1）数字化对所有样本的GTFP具有显著的正向影响。（2）HC和IS影响数字发展对长三角城市GTFP的促进作用，但在东北三省其影响不显著。（3）在HC和IS的影响下，刺激效应表现出显著的时空异质性。省会城市和经济发达城市的刺激影响最为突出。最后，基于数字发展与GTFP之间的非参数相关性，本文提出了建设性和实用的政策建议，以提升GTFP并促进绿色经济发展。

articles.title_en: Green investment and asset stranding under transition scenario uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 转型情景不确定性下的绿色投资与资产搁浅
articles.abstract_en: Risks and opportunities related to environmental transition are usually evaluated through the use of scenarios, produced and maintained by international bodies such as the International Energy Agency. This approach assumes perfect knowledge of the scenario by the agent, but in reality, scenario uncertainty is an important obstacle for making optimal investment or divestment decisions. In this paper, we develop a real-options approach to evaluate assets and potential investment projects under dynamic climate transition scenario uncertainty. We use off-the-shelf Integrated Assessment Model (IAM) scenarios and assume that the economic agent acquires the information about the scenario progressively by observing a signal, such as the carbon price or the greenhouse gas emissions. The problem of valuing an investment is formulated as an American option pricing problem, where the optimal exercise time corresponds to the time of entering a potential investment project or the time of selling a potentially stranded asset. To illustrate our approach, we employ representative scenarios from the scenario database of the Network for Greening the Financial System in two energy-related examples: the divestment decision from a coal-fired power plant without Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) technology and the potential investment into a green coal-fired power plant with CCS. In both cases, we find that the real option value is very sensitive to scenario uncertainty: the value of the coal-fired power plant is reduced by 25% and that of the green coal investment project is reduced by 7% when the agent deduces the scenario by observing carbon emissions, compared to the setting when the true scenario is known. We also find that scenario uncertainty can lead to considerable delays in the implementation of green investment projects, emphasizing the importance of timely and precise climate policy information.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境转型相关的风险和机遇通常通过使用国际机构（如国际能源署）制定和维护的情景来评估。这种方法假设经济主体对情景有完全了解，但实际上，情景不确定性是做出最优投资或撤资决策的重要障碍。在本文中，我们开发了一种实物期权方法，用于在动态气候转型情景不确定性下评估资产和潜在投资项目。我们使用现成的综合评估模型（IAM）情景，并假设经济主体通过观察信号（如碳价格或温室气体排放）逐步获取情景信息。投资估值问题被表述为美式期权定价问题，其中最优执行时间对应于进入潜在投资项目或出售潜在搁浅资产的时间。为了说明我们的方法，我们使用了绿色金融系统网络情景数据库中的代表性情景，在两个与能源相关的例子中：从没有碳捕集与封存（CCS）技术的燃煤电厂撤资的决策，以及投资于带有CCS的绿色燃煤电厂的潜在投资。在这两种情况下，我们发现实物期权价值对情景不确定性非常敏感：当经济主体通过观察碳排放来推断情景时，与真实情景已知的情况相比，燃煤电厂的价值降低了25%，绿色煤炭投资项目的价值降低了7%。我们还发现，情景不确定性可能导致绿色投资项目实施的显著延迟，强调了及时和精确的气候政策信息的重要性。

articles.title_en: Does industrial upgrading improve eco-efficiency? Evidence from China's industrial sector
articles.title_cn: 产业升级是否提升了生态效率？来自中国工业部门的证据
articles.abstract_en: Promoting industrial upgrading is the fundamental path for China to realize the coordination of industrial development and ecological protection. This paper firstly measures the industrial upgrading index (IUI) and eco-efficiency of 37 sub-industries in China's industrial sector based on the comprehensive weighting method and super-efficiency slacks-based measure model, and then for the first time, examines the impact of industrial upgrading on China's industrial eco-efficiency and its differences among industries and influential mechanisms using the panel data models. The following main conclusions are obtained. First, both the IUI and eco-efficiency of China's whole industrial sector showed an upward trend from 2005 to 2019. Second, there are significant gaps in the IUI and eco-efficiency among industries, and these gaps gradually increase in 2005–2019. Third, industrial upgrading significantly improves China's industrial eco-efficiency, and the results of robustness test also support this conclusion. Fourth, industrial upgrading positively affects the eco-efficiency of both high-pollution and low-pollution industries, and the positive effect on low-pollution industries is slightly greater than that on high-pollution industries. Fifth, industrial upgrading improves industrial eco-efficiency by enhancing production efficiency and energy utilization efficiency and optimizing energy consumption structure.
articles.abstract_cn: 推动产业升级是实现中国产业发展与生态保护协调发展的根本路径。本文首先基于综合加权法和超效率SBM模型测度了中国工业部门37个细分行业的产业升级指数（IUI）和生态效率，然后首次利用面板数据模型考察了产业升级对中国工业生态效率的影响、行业差异及作用机制。主要结论如下：第一，2005年至2019年间，中国整个工业部门的IUI和生态效率均呈上升趋势。第二，各行业间的IUI和生态效率存在显著差距，且这些差距在2005-2019年间逐渐扩大。第三，产业升级显著提升了中国工业生态效率，稳健性检验结果也支持这一结论。第四，产业升级对高污染行业和低污染行业的生态效率均产生正向影响，且对低污染行业的正向影响略大于高污染行业。第五，产业升级通过提高生产效率和能源利用效率以及优化能源消费结构来提升工业生态效率。

articles.title_en: Induced green innovation of suppliers: The “green power” from major customers
articles.title_cn: 供应商的诱导性绿色创新：大客户的“绿色力量”
articles.abstract_en: In the context of green development, the major challenge is to incentivize companies as key players to participate in green innovation. This paper focuses on the market incentive mechanism for green innovation to investigate whether major customers with green development concepts can enhance the green innovation of upstream suppliers, which means the “green power” from major customers. The research is based on paired data of Chinese A-share listed companies and their major clients from 2009 to 2018. The findings show that: (1) Major customers with green development concepts can enhance the green innovation of upstream suppliers, and this conclusion remains robust after a series of tests. (2) The study also identifies the influence mechanisms, which include: (a increasing the purchase amount to green suppliers, and (b providing green innovation-related resource support to upstream suppliers. (3) Heterogeneity analysis shows that major customers with green development concepts can significantly drive the green innovation of private and smaller suppliers to a greater extent. (4) The induced green innovation of suppliers from major accounts is more significant in samples with high customer concentration. This research identifies the “green power” from major customers as an important market mechanism for incentivizing green innovation. The conclusions of this paper will lead to some policy implications for the promotion of green innovation and the construction of green supply chains.
articles.abstract_cn: 在绿色发展的背景下，主要挑战在于激励作为关键参与者的企业参与绿色创新。本文聚焦于绿色创新的市场激励机制，探讨具有绿色发展理念的大客户能否提升上游供应商的绿色创新，即大客户的“绿色力量”。研究基于2009年至2018年中国A股上市公司及其主要客户的配对数据。研究发现：（1）具有绿色发展理念的大客户能够提升上游供应商的绿色创新，这一结论在经过一系列测试后依然稳健。（2）研究还识别了影响机制，包括：（a）增加对绿色供应商的采购金额，以及（b）向上游供应商提供与绿色创新相关的资源支持。（3）异质性分析表明，具有绿色发展理念的大客户能在更大程度上显著推动民营和小型供应商的绿色创新。（4）大客户对供应商的诱导性绿色创新在客户集中度高的样本中更为显著。本研究识别出大客户的“绿色力量”作为激励绿色创新的重要市场机制。本文的结论将为促进绿色创新和构建绿色供应链提供一些政策启示。

articles.title_en: Cap-and-trade mechanisms, green technology investment, and shadow insurance in a black swan environment
articles.title_cn: 总量控制与交易机制、绿色技术投资与黑天鹅环境下的影子保险
articles.abstract_en: This study aims to evaluate an insurer's equity during a black swan event by developing a capped call option model. The capped call captures the lending-borrowing relationship by integrating the credit risk from the carbon emission reductions of the carbon-intensive borrowing firm with the insurer's shadow insurance in an imperfectly competitive life insurance market. We show that the borrowing firm invests significantly in green technology, increasing its equity value and the insurer's interest margin, but harms policyholders. Increasing shadow insurance enhances the insurer's interest margin and firm equity. Moreover, we find that stringent cap regulation of the cap-and-trade scheme decreases the insurer's interest margin when the black swan impact becomes significant. This strict cap regulation helps policyholder protection, but harms borrowing firm equity. We suggest that the government shrink the cap of the cap-and-trade scheme, contributing to insurance stability. Colossal black swan increases the insurer's interest margin, policyholder protection, and borrowing firm equity. In conclusion, we show that the capped call option model is relevant to green finance for an insurer-borrowing firm.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究旨在通过开发一个封顶看涨期权模型来评估保险公司在黑天鹅事件中的权益。该封顶看涨期权通过将碳密集型借款企业的碳减排信用风险与保险公司在非完全竞争人寿保险市场中的影子保险相结合，捕捉了借贷关系。我们表明，借款企业在绿色技术上的投资显著增加，提高了其股权价值和保险公司的利差，但损害了保单持有人的利益。增加影子保险增强了保险公司的利差和公司股权。此外，我们发现，当黑天鹅影响变得显著时，总量控制与交易计划的严格上限监管降低了保险公司的利差。这种严格的上限监管有助于保护保单持有人，但损害了借款企业的股权。我们建议政府缩小总量控制与交易计划的上限，以促进保险稳定。巨大的黑天鹅事件增加了保险公司的利差、保单持有人保护和借款企业的股权。总之，我们表明封顶看涨期权模型与保险公司-借款企业的绿色金融相关。

articles.title_en: Is market power the cause of asymmetric pricing in China's refined oil market?
articles.title_cn: 市场势力是中国成品油市场价格不对称的原因吗？
articles.abstract_en: The asymmetric response of Chinese refined oil prices to crude oil prices is essentially an issue of economic efficiency, and the collusion of the oil oligarchs is not conducive to the market-oriented reform and economic sustainability. The purpose of this paper is to test whether the prices of refined oil products in China does indeed have the asymmetric fluctuations of “rising more and falling less”, and to analyze whether there are unreasonable pricing behaviors colluding among oil companies. We first examine the relationship between refined oil prices and the crude oil price by applying the NARDL using the monthly data from June 2000 to May 2021, and then designs a two-stage regression process based on the EGARCH model to check whether the asymmetric pricing is the result of the market power formed by the oligopolistic collusion. The results show that the asymmetric reaction of gasoline and diesel prices to crude oil prices in China is basically the same. Only the long-run asymmetry has been confirmed while the short-run asymmetry has not passed the test. The long-term equilibrium price amid fluctuations in Chinese refined oil prices is slowly being pulled higher, most likely due to the increased market power of oil companies. Long term asymmetry means that the oligopoly market equilibrium is approaching monopoly. The cause is in the refining segment of refined oil, not in the retail segment because the EGARCH model has only successfully identified the market power in the refining sector. The joint tests indicate that the oil oligarchs may have passed the cost information, which is conducive to raising prices in the long term, to the price regulators, and there is an unreasonable part of China's refined oil prices that undermine market efficiency.
articles.abstract_cn: 中国成品油价格对原油价格的不对称反应本质上是一个经济效率问题，石油寡头的合谋不利于市场化改革和经济可持续性。本文旨在检验中国成品油价格是否确实存在“涨多跌少”的不对称波动，并分析石油公司之间是否存在不合理的合谋定价行为。我们首先利用2000年六月至2021年五月的月度数据，应用NARDL模型考察成品油价格与原油价格之间的关系，然后基于EGARCH模型设计两阶段回归过程，检验不对称定价是否是寡头合谋形成的市场势力的结果。结果表明，中国汽油和柴油价格对原油价格的不对称反应基本相同。仅确认了长期不对称性，而短期不对称性未通过检验。中国成品油价格波动中的长期均衡价格正缓慢被推高，这很可能归因于石油公司市场势力的增强。长期不对称意味着寡头市场均衡正趋近于垄断。其原因在于成品油的炼油环节，而非零售环节，因为EGARCH模型仅成功识别了炼油部门的市场势力。联合检验表明，石油寡头可能已将有利于长期提价的成本信息传递给价格监管机构，中国成品油价格中存在损害市场效率的不合理部分。

articles.title_en: Dynamic effects and driving intermediations of oil price shocks on major economies
articles.title_cn: 油价冲击对主要经济体的动态效应与驱动中介机制
articles.abstract_en: Interest in oil price shocks' economic effects has grown in recent years. However, previous studies mostly failed to clarify the dynamic transmissions of oil price shocks on representative economies from global and driver perspectives, even ignoring oil price fluctuations when linking oil prices and economy together. This paper examines the dynamic relationships and driving intermediations between multiple oil price shocks and macroeconomy by applying Bayesian vector autoregressive models with stochastic volatility and time-varying parameters, using the USA, China, the Euro-19, and Japan as research objects. Results show that, in the whole sample, all oil prices have the strongest effects on Japan, followed by China, Euro-19, and the USA, with possible directional differences. All oil prices' economic effects intensified during the crisis and Covid-19, accompanying significant oil price fluctuations. Regarding asymmetry, in the whole sample and critical times, stronger effects of rising oil prices show in the short term, but opposite in the long term. Consumer price, interest rate, and exchange rate are the general intermediations of oil prices in China and the USA, Euro-19, and Japan, respectively, and exchange rate is the additional intermediation in China, Euro-19, and Japan during the crisis and Covid-19. Overall, the results are solid.
articles.abstract_cn: 近年来，油价冲击的经济效应引起了越来越多的关注。然而，以往的研究大多未能从全球和驱动因素的角度阐明油价冲击对代表性经济体的动态传导，甚至在将油价与经济联系起来时忽略了油价波动。本文以美国、中国、欧元19和日本为研究对象，采用具有随机波动率和时变参数的贝叶斯向量自回归模型，考察了多种油价冲击与宏观经济之间的动态关系和驱动中介机制。结果表明，在整个样本中，所有油价对日本的影响最强，其次是中国、欧元19和美国，且可能存在方向性差异。在危机和新冠19期间，所有油价的经济效应均有所增强，并伴随显著的油价波动。关于不对称性，在整个样本和关键时期，短期内油价上涨的影响更强，但长期则相反。消费者价格、利率和汇率分别是中国、美国、欧元19和日本油价的一般中介变量，而在危机和新冠19期间，汇率是中国、欧元19和日本的额外中介变量。总体而言，结果是稳健的。

articles.title_en: Is information and communication technology a driver for renewable energy?
articles.title_cn: 信息通信技术是否为可再生能源的驱动力？
articles.abstract_en: Renewable energy (RE) has become the biggest driving force to achieve sustainable development. This research hence explores the impact of information and communication technology (ICT) on RE by accounting for country risk (CR) as an interaction term with a sample of 126 nations from 2000 to 2019. Using the Method of Moments Quantile Regression (MMQR), we find that the positive impacts of Internet usage, secure network services, and high-tech exports are more effective in assisting RE output when nations have a lower level of RE output, while fixed broadband subscriptions are more effective for higher RE output nations. Lastly, CR affects the causal connection between RE output and ICT. Our findings offer insights for policymakers to consider their CR, RE condition, and varying impacts of different ICTs in order to advance both RE and ICT usages.
articles.abstract_cn: 可再生能源（RE）已成为实现可持续发展的最大推动力。因此，本研究通过将国家风险（CR）作为交互项，以2000年至2019年间126个国家为样本，探讨了信息通信技术（ICT）对可再生能源的影响。运用矩分位数回归方法（MMQR），我们发现，当国家可再生能源产出水平较低时，互联网使用、安全网络服务和高技术出口对促进可再生能源产出的积极影响更为有效，而固定宽带订阅对可再生能源产出较高的国家更为有效。最后，国家风险影响可再生能源产出与信息通信技术之间的因果关系。我们的发现为政策制定者提供了见解，使其在推进可再生能源和信息通信技术应用时，需考虑国家风险、可再生能源状况以及不同信息通信技术的差异化影响。

articles.title_en: Price risk transmissions in the water-energy-food nexus: Impacts of climate risks and portfolio implications
articles.title_cn: 水-能源-粮食关联中的价格风险传导：气候风险的影响与投资组合含义
articles.abstract_en: The water-energy-food (WEF) nexus has quickly materialized as a critical factor that could threaten sustainable development goals. To contribute to the understanding of the WEF nexus from an economic perspective, this study investigates the price risk transmissions among the water, energy, and agricultural markets. We further analyze the critical impacts of climate risks, including physical and transition risks, on the transmission behaviors. Employing a quantile connectedness approach in the time-frequency domain, we provide a comprehensive analysis that allows for the consideration of different market conditions (extreme vs. normal) and time horizons (long vs. short). We find that the WEF nexus is relatively small in a normal market condition but increases substantially in an extreme market condition. The nexus is more pronounced in the short-term horizon compared to the long-term horizon. Among investigated factors, the U.S. climate policy and economic policy uncertainty have generally strengthened the WEF nexus while geopolitical risk and U.S. term spread tend to weaken the nexus. Analyzing the impacts of climate risks in detail, we find that in the short term, investors worry more about transition risks rather than physical risks in a normal market condition. In the long term, investors integrate information on both transition and physical risks but only in an extreme market condition. Our analysis of the economic implications further supports the view that investors care more about transition risks than physical risks when forming investment portfolios.
articles.abstract_cn: 水-能源-粮食（WEF）关联已迅速成为可能威胁可持续发展目标的关键因素。为从经济学角度增进对WEF关联的理解，本研究考察了水、能源和农产品市场之间的价格风险传导。我们进一步分析了气候风险（包括物理风险和转型风险）对传导行为的关键影响。采用时频域的分位数连通性方法，我们提供了全面的分析，允许考虑不同的市场条件（极端与正常）和时间范围（长期与短期）。我们发现，WEF关联在正常市场条件下相对较小，但在极端市场条件下显著增大。该关联在短期范围内比长期范围更为显著。在考察的因素中，美国气候政策和经济政策不确定性总体上加强了WEF关联，而地缘政治风险和美国期限利差则倾向于削弱该关联。详细分析气候风险的影响后，我们发现，在短期内，投资者在正常市场条件下更担心转型风险而非物理风险。在长期内，投资者整合了转型风险和物理风险的信息，但仅在极端市场条件下如此。我们对经济影响的进一步分析支持了投资者在构建投资组合时更关注转型风险而非物理风险的观点。

articles.title_en: Does climate vulnerability promote green investment under energy supply restriction?
articles.title_cn: 能源供应限制下气候脆弱性是否促进绿色投资？
articles.abstract_en: This research investigates the impact of climate vulnerability on green investment using panel data of 107 countries over the period 1995–2019. We find that climate vulnerability reduces green investment in both climate change mitigation and climate change adaptation technologies. This finding holds up under a series of robustness tests and after taking into consideration the time lag effect, cross-sectional dependence, and endogenous problems. We further present that it is socioeconomic-related climate vulnerability that hinders green investment, whereas physical vulnerability does the opposite. Analyses of moderating channels show that the negative impact of climate vulnerability on green investment is more pronounced in countries with lower levels of adaptation readiness, economic development, and technical innovation, and higher levels of energy supply restriction.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究利用1995-2019年间107个国家的面板数据，考察了气候脆弱性对绿色投资的影响。我们发现，气候脆弱性减少了气候变化减缓技术和气候变化适应技术方面的绿色投资。这一发现在一系列稳健性检验以及考虑时间滞后效应、截面依赖和内生性问题后仍然成立。我们进一步指出，阻碍绿色投资的是与社会经济相关的气候脆弱性，而物理脆弱性则相反。调节渠道分析表明，气候脆弱性对绿色投资的负面影响在适应准备度、经济发展水平和技术创新能力较低以及能源供应限制程度较高的国家中更为显著。

articles.title_en: Climate change and fossil fuel prices: A GARCH-MIDAS analysis
articles.title_cn: 气候变化与化石燃料价格：基于GARCH-MIDAS的分析
articles.abstract_en: In this study, we investigate the connection between climate change and the volatility of fossil fuel prices using the GARCH-MIDAS framework which accommodates mixed data frequencies and by extension circumvents information loss due to splicing or aggregation of one variable for the other. We conduct a battery of robustness tests that allow for nominal and real prices of fossil fuels as well as global financial crises (GFC). We show a strong connection between climate change and the volatility of fossil fuel prices albeit with stronger evidence in the post-GFC period. The outcome is positive in the recent period and therefore climate change seems to have heightened the volatility in the fossil fuel market. Even when the real prices are considered, results remain consistent, indicating that inflationary pressures do not diminish the effect of climate change on fossil fuel price volatility. We also show that own market risk positively impacts the volatility of fossil fuel prices and the volatility tends to persist when there is a shock to the fossil fuel market. More conscious efforts are needed to effectively discourage increased investments in environmentally-degrading assets.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本研究中，我们利用GARCH-MIDAS框架探讨气候变化与化石燃料价格波动之间的联系，该框架能够适应混合数据频率，并由此避免因将一个变量拼接或聚合到另一个变量而导致的信息损失。我们进行了一系列稳健性检验，涵盖了化石燃料的名义价格和实际价格以及全球金融危机（GFC）。我们展示了气候变化与化石燃料价格波动之间的紧密联系，尽管在GFC后的时期证据更为显著。近期结果为正，因此气候变化似乎加剧了化石燃料市场的波动。即使考虑实际价格，结果仍然一致，表明通胀压力并未削弱气候变化对化石燃料价格波动的影响。我们还发现，自身市场风险对化石燃料价格波动有正向影响，且当化石燃料市场受到冲击时，波动往往具有持续性。需要更加有意识的努力，以有效抑制对环境有害资产的增加投资。

articles.title_en: Analyzing the influence of geopolitical risks on European power prices using a multiresolution causal neural network
articles.title_cn: 利用多分辨率因果神经网络分析地缘政治风险对欧洲电价的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper presents a rigorous investigation into the multiresolution cross-correlation and causality between European energy markets and geopolitical risk (GPR). Using daily electricity spot prices from January 2015 to January 2023, the study employs the variational mode decomposition (VMD) method to uncover the underlying patterns and reveal the interaction between European power prices and GPR. The paper further develops a VMD-assisted multi-scaled causal neural network (VMD-M-CNN) as a multivariable forecasting approach, benchmarking it against other competing models. The results demonstrate a strong dependence between electricity markets and GPR across different investment time-scale horizons. Additionally, the relationship between the two has taken different forms over the crisis period in contrast with calm periods. The proposed VMD-M-CNN approach proves to be more effective than other benchmark models, providing valuable insights for market participants and policymakers to make informed decisions. The rigorous methodology employed and the novel approach developed enhance the credibility and robustness of the study, contributing to the growing body of literature on energy markets and GPR.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文对欧洲能源市场与地缘政治风险（GPR）之间的多分辨率互相关性和因果关系进行了严谨的研究。研究使用从2015年一月至2023年一月的每日电力现货价格，采用变分模态分解（VMD）方法揭示潜在模式，并展现欧洲电价与GPR之间的相互作用。本文进一步开发了一种VMD辅助的多尺度因果神经网络（VMD-M-CNN）作为多变量预测方法，并与其他竞争模型进行了基准比较。结果表明，在不同的投资时间尺度范围内，电力市场与GPR之间存在强烈的依赖性。此外，与平静时期相比，危机期间两者之间的关系呈现出不同形式。所提出的VMD-M-CNN方法被证明比其他基准模型更有效，为市场参与者和政策制定者提供了宝贵的见解，以做出明智的决策。所采用的严谨方法论和开发的新方法增强了研究的可信度和稳健性，为能源市场和GPR领域的文献增长做出了贡献。

articles.title_en: Performance evaluation of Indian electricity distribution companies: An integrated DEA-IRP-TOPSIS approach
articles.title_cn: 印度配电公司绩效评估：一种集成的DEA-IRP-TOPSIS方法
articles.abstract_en: Energy is a fundamental building block of human growth and plays a significant role in developing emerging economies such as India. The Indian electricity sector has a strong generation and transmission system but a weak distribution system. This is considered the weakest link in the electricity sector's value chain, and regulators are primarily concerned with the performance of electricity distribution companies (DISCOMs). Despite numerous reforms introduced to attain financial sustainability, most DISCOMs consistently incur losses and are financially unsustainable. Therefore, evaluating the performance of DISCOMs is essential by measuring their efficiency to ensure competition among them and to make reforms successful. This study aimed to identify and compare the performance efficiencies of 48 electricity DISCOMs from 24 states across India between 2015/16 and 2018/19. This study used the integrated DEA-IRP-TOPSIS technique to segment efficient and inefficient DISCOMs. The study recommends that states provide operational and financial autonomy to power Discoms. The study will be helpful for DISCOMs professionals to understand their performance and design suitable strategies based on efficiency assessments and their position concerning their peers. By comparing Indian DISCOMs with their contemporaries, this study contributes new evidence at the policy level and to the literature on the efficiency analysis of Indian DISCOMs.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源是人类增长的基本组成部分，在印度等新兴经济体的发展中发挥着重要作用。印度电力部门拥有强大的发电和输电系统，但配电系统薄弱。这被认为是电力部门价值链中最薄弱的环节，监管机构主要关注配电公司（DISCOMs）的绩效。尽管为获得财务可持续性进行了多项改革，但大多数DISCOMs持续亏损，财务上不可持续。因此，通过衡量其效率来评估DISCOMs的绩效至关重要，以确保它们之间的竞争并使改革成功。本研究旨在识别并比较2015/16至2018/19年间来自印度24个邦的48家电力配电公司的绩效效率。本研究使用集成的DEA-IRP-TOPSIS技术来区分高效和低效的DISCOMs。研究建议各邦向电力配电公司提供运营和财务自主权。该研究将有助于DISCOMs专业人员了解其绩效，并根据效率评估及其相对于同行的位置设计合适的策略。通过将印度DISCOMs与其同行进行比较，本研究在政策层面和印度DISCOMs效率分析文献方面提供了新的证据。

articles.title_en: Determinants and real effects of joint hedging: An empirical analysis of US oil and gas producers
articles.title_cn: 联合对冲的决定因素与实际效应：美国油气生产商的实证分析
articles.abstract_en: We study the intensity of joint hedging of oil and gas prices by US petroleum firms. We aim to explain the rationale for and find the determinants of joint hedging, as well as its impact on firm market value, performance, and riskiness. Joint hedging that takes into account the interdependence between risks should have a positive impact on firm value in the presence of multiple risks. We verify this theory in an innovative way, by testing the effects of hedging oil and gas prices simultaneously and by using an instrumental variable framework to attenuate the problem of endogeneity between firm value and risk management. We find evidence of higher market value, higher accounting performance, and lower riskiness for firms with a high propensity to jointly hedge their oil and gas production to a greater extent. We show that joint hedging dominates single-commodity hedging.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了美国石油公司对石油和天然气价格进行联合对冲的强度。我们旨在解释联合对冲的理由，找出其决定因素，以及其对公司市场价值、业绩和风险的影响。在存在多重风险的情况下，考虑风险之间相互依赖性的联合对冲应对公司价值产生积极影响。我们通过同时测试对冲石油和天然气价格的效果，并使用工具变量框架来减弱公司价值与风险管理之间的内生性问题，以创新方式验证了这一理论。我们发现，对于高度倾向于更大程度联合对冲其石油和天然气生产的公司，有证据表明其市场价值更高、会计业绩更好、风险更低。我们表明，联合对冲优于单一商品对冲。

articles.title_en: Environmental regulation and corporate employment revisited: New quasi-natural experimental evidence from China's new environmental protection law
articles.title_cn: 环境规制与企业就业再探：来自中国新环境保护法的新准自然实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates how environmental regulation affects corporate hiring decisions. Using the enactment of China's New Environmental Protection Law in 2015 as an exogenously regulatory shock, we run a difference-in-differences regression to identify causality. The results show that stricter environmental regulation significantly reduces corporate employment by approximately 5.1% on average. This negative effect is stronger for firms with greater liquidity constraints, worse environmental performance, higher labor intensity, more severe labor market frictions, and regions under stricter law enforcement. In addition, the mechanism tests reveal that stricter environmental regulation conduces to higher environmental risks, less debt financing, and higher liquidity constraints, which is consistent with the financial constraints channel. Overall, the government should take the employment destruction effect of environmental regulation seriously, especially during periods of climate warming and the coronavirus disease pandemic.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了环境规制如何影响企业的雇佣决策。利用2015年中国新环境保护法的颁布作为外生监管冲击，我们进行了双重差分回归以识别因果关系。结果表明，更严格的环境规制显著降低了企业就业，平均约降低5.1%。这种负面效应在流动性约束更大、环境绩效更差、劳动密集度更高、劳动力市场摩擦更严重以及法律执行更严格的地区的企业中更为明显。此外，机制检验显示，更严格的环境规制导致更高的环境风险、更少的债务融资和更高的流动性约束，这与金融约束渠道一致。总体而言，政府应认真对待环境规制的就业破坏效应，尤其是在气候变暖和冠状病毒病大流行时期。

articles.title_en: Integration of power-to-gas into electricity markets during the ramp-up phase—Assessing the role of carbon pricing
articles.title_cn: 电力市场在爬坡阶段对电转气的整合——评估碳定价的作用
articles.abstract_en: The expansion of wind and solar energy has so far primarily led to the decarbonization of the electricity sector. Against this background, power-to-gas (PtG) is seen as a solution supporting the decarbonization of other sectors, such as heating or transport. As the generation mix will transitionally be based on fossil-fired generation technologies, the upcoming integration of PtG into electricity markets comes with several challenges. While the current debate focuses on sustainability criteria and support mechanisms, integration of PtG into electricity markets requires a further development of the market design. Notably, the design of electricity markets and carbon pricing should create efficient incentives for utilizing PtG, reflecting the value of the CO2 emissions avoided by electrolytic hydrogen or methane. General effects are analyzed to study the role of carbon pricing in integrating PtG. Moreover, a detailed bottom-up market model is extended by the PtG technology and competing flexibilities, such as storage or demand-side management. Several scenarios are developed regarding levels of CO2 price, techno-economic parameters of flexibilities and shares of variable renewable energy sources for 2025. The results reveal that carbon pricing has to reflect both the avoided and the induced CO2 emissions related to electrolytic hydrogen or methane to support the market integration of PtG during the ramp-up phase. On the contrary, too low CO2 prices might lead to adverse effects. Subsequently, implications for energy policy are discussed.
articles.abstract_cn: 风能和太阳能的扩张迄今主要导致了电力部门的脱碳。在此背景下，电转气（PtG）被视为支持供暖或交通等其他部门脱碳的解决方案。由于发电组合在过渡期将基于化石燃料发电技术，PtG即将整合到电力市场中带来了一些挑战。虽然当前的讨论集中在可持续性标准和扶持机制上，但将PtG整合到电力市场需要进一步发展市场设计。特别是，电力市场的设计和碳定价应创造有效激励以利用PtG，反映通过电解氢或甲烷避免的CO2排放的价值。分析了总体效应以研究碳定价在整合PtG中的作用。此外，一个详细的自下而上的市场模型被扩展，加入了PtG技术和竞争性灵活性措施，如储能或需求侧管理。针对2025年的CO2价格水平、灵活性的技术经济参数以及可变可再生能源份额，开发了多种情景。结果表明，碳定价必须同时反映与电解氢或甲烷相关的避免和诱导的CO2排放，以支持PtG在爬坡阶段的市场整合。相反，过低的CO2价格可能导致不利影响。随后，讨论了对能源政策的启示。

articles.title_en: Spatial spillovers and world energy intensity convergence
articles.title_cn: 空间溢出效应与世界能源强度趋同
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the influence of spatial spillovers on energy intensity growth and convergence across 153 countries from 1999 to 2018. The inclusion of spatially lagged variables allows the study of the influence of trade, technological diffusion and policy mimicry on these two processes. Contrary to previous literature, we consider different spatial specifications and weight matrices to test whether spatial spillovers are exogenous or endogenous, as well as their range of influence. Our study finds the spatial lag of X model (SLX), with local spatial weight matrices, fits better to the data. Convergence is found for the world as a whole, conditional to the spatial distribution of countries and several long-term economic characteristics. In this sense, clusters of nearby countries present higher rates of convergence. Besides, domestic capital accumulation, total factor productivity growth and renewable energy consumption significantly determine the characteristics of clubs of convergence. Furthermore, spatial spillovers associated to capital accumulation, population growth and renewable energy consumption also contribute to the definition of these clubs.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了1999年至2018年间空间溢出效应对153个国家能源强度增长和趋同的影响。纳入空间滞后变量使得研究贸易、技术扩散和政策模仿对这两个过程的影响成为可能。与以往文献不同，我们考虑了不同的空间设定和权重矩阵，以检验空间溢出是外生的还是内生的，以及它们的影响范围。我们的研究发现，具有局部空间权重矩阵的空间滞后X模型（SLX）更符合数据。在考虑国家空间分布和若干长期经济特征的条件下，世界整体存在趋同。在此意义上，邻近国家的集群表现出更高的趋同率。此外，国内资本积累、全要素生产率增长和可再生能源消费显著决定了趋同俱乐部的特征。而且，与资本积累、人口增长和可再生能源消费相关的空间溢出效应也有助于这些俱乐部的定义。

articles.title_en: Are tax revenue recycling schemes based on industry-differentiated carbon tax conducive to realizing the “double dividend”?
articles.title_cn: 基于行业差异化碳税的税收返还方案是否有利于实现“双重红利”？
articles.abstract_en: Carbon tax policies based on industry differences can produce better emission reductions, but their economic losses have not been fully considered. To guarantee the fairness and economic effectiveness of the carbon emission reduction, this paper explores the policy impacts of revenue recycling schemes based on industry-differentiated carbon taxes using a dynamic CGE model. The findings show that revenue recycling schemes can effectively mitigate the negative macroeconomic and industry output impacts of industry-differentiated carbon taxes, but also affects their carbon reduction effects. The indirect carbon tax revenue recycling schemes are more beneficial than the direct recycling schemes in reducing GDP loss, and corporate income tax reduction is most effective in mitigating the reduction in fixed asset investment. The applicability of different carbon tax revenue recycling schemes varies across industries, and in general corporate income tax reduction and subsidies to clean energy industries are more beneficial to carbon emission reduction, and indirect carbon tax revenue recycling schemes that reduce residential and corporate income taxes can achieve stronger “double dividend”. This paper suggests that China should adopt a industry-differentiated carbon tax with a fair distribution of emission reduction responsibilities, while achieving a “double dividend” through appropriate revenue recycling schemes.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于行业差异的碳税政策可以产生更好的减排效果，但其经济损失尚未得到充分考虑。为保证碳减排的公平性和经济有效性，本文利用动态CGE模型探讨了基于行业差异化碳税的税收返还方案的政策影响。研究结果表明，税收返还方案能有效缓解行业差异化碳税对宏观经济和行业产出的负面影响，但也会影响其碳减排效果。间接碳税收入返还方案在减少GDP损失方面比直接返还方案更有利，而企业所得税减免在缓解固定资产投资下降方面最为有效。不同碳税收入返还方案的适用性因行业而异，总体而言，企业所得税减免和对清洁能源行业的补贴更有利于碳减排，而减少居民和企业所得税的间接碳税收入返还方案可以实现更强的“双重红利”。本文建议中国应采用行业差异化碳税，公平分配减排责任，同时通过适当的收入返还方案实现“双重红利”。

articles.title_en: Measuring the energy-related uncertainty index
articles.title_cn: 测量与能源相关的不确定性指数
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a novel energy-related uncertainty index (the EUI). We use the text analysis of the monthly country reports of the Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU) to construct the EUI, which measures the uncertainties related to energy markets for 28 developed and developing countries from 1996 to 2022 using. We use the vector autoregression (VAR) model and a range of other estimation methods to evaluate and check the efficacy of the EUI. The EUI appears to respond strongly to oil shocks, including sharp drops in oil prices. We also find that the EUI and other measures of uncertainties spiked during the global financial crisis, the European debt crises, the Covid-19 pandemic, and the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Further analysis confirms that an increase in the EUI tends to hinder economic activities and outputs, not only at a country level but also at an industry level.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种新颖的能源相关不确定性指数（EUI）。我们利用经济学人智库 (EIU) 月度国家报告的文本分析来构建 EUI，它衡量 28 发达国家和发展中国家从 1996 到 2022 使用的能源市场相关的不确定性。我们使用向量自回归（VAR）模型和一系列其他估计方法来评估和检查 EUI 的有效性。 EUI 似乎对石油冲击做出了强烈反应，包括油价大幅下跌。我们还发现，在全球金融危机、欧洲债务危机、新冠病毒19大流行以及俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间，EUI 和其他不确定性指标急剧上升。进一步的分析证实，EUI 的增加往往会阻碍经济活动和产出，不仅在国家层面，而且在行业层面。

articles.title_en: Pathway to prosperity? The impact of low-carbon energy transition on China's common prosperity
articles.title_cn: 通往繁荣之路？低碳能源转型对中国共同富裕的影响
articles.abstract_en: Given the ongoing low-carbon energy transition in China, the social, economic, and environmental consequences of this transition cannot be overlooked. Achieving common prosperity is a key component of China's agenda, so it is important to consider the potential nexus between common prosperity and the low-carbon energy transition. Therefore, this study first offers a new comprehensive measure of common prosperity. Furthermore, we examine the impact of the low-carbon energy transition on common prosperity by applying the system-generalized method of moments (SYS-GMM) approach. The key conclusions reached regarding the impact of the low-carbon energy transition on common prosperity are: (1) the degree of common prosperity has continued to increase between 2006 and 2019; (2) the low-carbon energy transition significantly promotes common prosperity; (3) the low-carbon energy transition indirectly promotes common prosperity by expanding gross fixed capital formation, improving labor productivity, and promoting industrial structure upgrading; and (4) the low-carbon energy transition has a significantly stronger impact on common prosperity in provinces with higher levels of low-carbon energy transition and common prosperity. Finally, we suggest several policy implications for promoting low-carbon energy transition and common prosperity.
articles.abstract_cn: 鉴于中国正在进行的低碳能源转型，这一转型的社会、经济和环境后果不容忽视。实现共同富裕是中国议程的关键组成部分，因此考虑共同富裕与低碳能源转型之间的潜在联系非常重要。因此，本研究首先提出了一个全新的共同富裕综合衡量指标。此外，我们通过应用系统广义矩估计（SYS-GMM）方法，考察了低碳能源转型对共同富裕的影响。关于低碳能源转型对共同富裕影响的主要结论是：（1）2006年至2019年间，共同富裕程度持续提高；（2）低碳能源转型显著促进共同富裕；（3）低碳能源转型通过扩大固定资本形成总额、提高劳动生产率和促进产业结构升级间接促进共同富裕；（4）在低碳能源转型水平和共同富裕程度较高的省份，低碳能源转型对共同富裕的影响显著更强。最后，我们提出了若干促进低碳能源转型和共同富裕的政策建议。

articles.title_en: The impact of consumer confidence on oil prices
articles.title_cn: 消费者信心对油价的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the interrelationship between Chinese consumer confidence (CC) and the oil market by testing the full-sample and sub-sample. Some empirical conclusions show that CC can positively impact oil price (OP) manifested as high confidence may boost oil demand and lead to higher prices. However, the negative effects of CC on OP cannot support this view, mainly due to the lack of confidence that will lead to lower demand and excess oil supply, which can cause OP to decline while CC remains high. This can be explained by the fact that low OP leads consumers to spend more money on non-essential goods and boost CC. These negative impacts emphasise that economic turmoil will affect OP fluctuation, which makes it different from the intertemporal capital asset pricing model. Under the uncertain oil market, these conclusions benefit Chinese consumers and the government by adjusting oil reserves and steadying national economic growth. It inspires enterprises and the government to prevent sudden changes in OP and stabilise CC.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过检验全样本和子样本，研究了中国消费者信心（CC）与石油市场之间的相互关系。一些实证结论表明，CC可以对油价（OP）产生正向影响，表现为高信心可能提振石油需求并导致价格上升。然而，CC对OP的负面影响并不支持这一观点，这主要是因为信心不足将导致需求下降和石油供应过剩，从而在CC保持高位时引起OP下跌。这可以解释为低OP促使消费者在非必需品上花费更多，从而提振CC。这些负面影响强调经济动荡将影响OP波动，这使其不同于跨期资本资产定价模型。在不确定的石油市场下，这些结论通过调整石油储备和稳定国家经济增长，有利于中国消费者和政府。它激励企业和政府防范OP的突变并稳定CC。

articles.title_en: Does institutional quality affect CO2 emissions? Evidence from explainable artificial intelligence models
articles.title_cn: 制度质量是否影响二氧化碳排放？来自可解释人工智能模型的证据
articles.abstract_en: Although the debate regarding the impact of high-quality institutional measures to address climate change associated with global carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions has gained increasing attention, there is insufficient quantitative evidence to support this debate. Using data from 136 countries between 1996 and 2016, we provide unique and compelling evidence that transcendent institutional measures and conscious government policies for environmentally sound and sustainable economic growth can effectively reduce CO2 emissions. Our research reveals that effective climate change policies must be associated with improvement in at least three main institutional dimensions: protection of property rights (the rule of law), citizens' participation in elections and freedom of expression (voice), and control of corruption. Climate-friendly economic policies must consider improving such institutional features while simultaneously advancing economic development, increasing the use of renewable energy by private and public entities, and significantly reducing the consumption of fossil fuels.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管关于高质量制度措施应对与全球二氧化碳排放相关的气候变化的争论日益受到关注，但支持这一争论的定量证据尚不充分。利用1996年至2016年间136个国家的数据，我们提供了独特且令人信服的证据，表明超越性的制度措施和有意识的政府政策，若旨在实现环境友好和可持续的经济增长，可以有效减少二氧化碳排放。我们的研究揭示，有效的气候变化政策必须与至少三个主要制度维度的改善相关联：产权保护（法治）、公民参与选举和言论自由（发言权）以及腐败控制。气候友好型经济政策必须在推进经济发展的同时，考虑改善此类制度特征，增加私人和公共实体对可再生能源的使用，并显著减少化石燃料的消费。

articles.title_en: Energy inflation and consumption inequality
articles.title_cn: 能源通胀与消费不平等
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of higher energy prices on consumption inequality for a large panel of 129 advanced and developing economies during the period 1970–2013. The results suggest that energy inflation increases the Gini measure of consumption inequality and reduces (increases) the share of consumption of lower (higher) income deciles. These effects are larger in developing economies, in countries with limited access to finance, in those with weaker monetary policy frameworks, during periods of economic slack and in cases where government transfers do not compensate the poorer deciles during times of adverse income shocks.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了1970-2013年间129个发达经济体和发展中经济体组成的大面板数据中能源价格上涨对消费不平等的影响。结果表明，能源通胀加剧了消费不平等的基尼系数，并降低了（提高了）低收入（高收入）十分位组的消费份额。这些影响在发展中经济体、金融获取受限的国家、货币政策框架较弱的国家、经济萧条时期以及政府转移支付未能在不利收入冲击期间补偿较贫困十分位组的情况下更为显著。

articles.title_en: A wavelet-based methodology to compare the impact of pandemic versus Russia–Ukraine conflict on crude oil sector and its interconnectedness with other energy and non-energy markets
articles.title_cn: 基于小波的方法比较疫情与俄乌冲突对原油行业的影响及其与其他能源和非能源市场的互联性
articles.abstract_en: We address the important question of whether the COVID-19 pandemic and the Russia–Ukraine conflict have the same economic impact. Our study focuses on a comparative analysis of the crude oil markets with other energy and non-energy markets in terms of market efficiency and interconnectedness during the two crises. We deploy a novel methodology that utilizes the wavelet decomposition of time series, which facilitates capturing of information in both time and frequency domain, to evaluate the market efficiency. Subsequently, the wavelet coherence, along with a vector-valued GARCH model applied on the wavelet details, help us in quantifying the interconnectedness and spillover dynamics between different markets. Our analysis suggests that the energy sector is impacted more than the non-energy sector in times of both the crises, however the nature of the impact is different for different energy markets. Brent crude oil suffers more during the Russia–Ukraine war than during the pandemic, while natural gas suffers more during the pandemic than the war and WTI suffers equally during both the crises. We also report increased interconnectedness between markets during the pandemic and the war. This information would help investors to choose a safe market and plan their portfolio accordingly in a crisis period.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们探讨了一个重要问题，即COVID-19疫情和俄乌冲突是否具有相同的经济影响。我们的研究侧重于在两次危机期间，原油市场与其他能源和非能源市场在市场效率和互联性方面的比较分析。我们采用了一种新颖的方法，利用时间序列的小波分解，这有助于在时间和频率域中捕捉信息，以评估市场效率。随后，小波相干性以及应用于小波细节的向量值GARCH模型，帮助我们量化不同市场之间的互联性和溢出动态。我们的分析表明，在两次危机期间，能源部门受到的影响大于非能源部门，但不同能源市场受影响的性质不同。布伦特原油在俄乌战争期间比疫情期间遭受的损失更大，而天然气在疫情期间比战争期间遭受的损失更大，WTI在两次危机中遭受的损失相同。我们还报告了疫情期间和战争期间市场之间互联性的增强。这些信息将有助于投资者在危机时期选择安全的市场并相应规划其投资组合。

articles.title_en: Does green improve portfolio optimisation?
articles.title_cn: 绿色资产能否改善投资组合优化？
articles.abstract_en: Our study uses the GARCH-EVT-copula model to develop out-of-sample forecasts for diverse asset classes, including a green asset. To construct optimal portfolios, we apply four different portfolio allocation techniques: equal weighting, minimum variance, global minimum variance (GMV), and certainty equivalence tangency (CET) criteria. The results demonstrate that the GMV portfolio outperforms other portfolios in risk measures. Further, backtesting evidence shows that the portfolio containing a green asset performs better than the benchmark for short horizons. The results have implications for fund managers and policymakers since green asset provides valuable diversification benefits and further the cause of sustainable development.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们的研究使用GARCH-EVT-copula模型对包括绿色资产在内的多种资产类别进行样本外预测。为了构建最优投资组合，我们应用了四种不同的投资组合配置技术：等权重、最小方差、全局最小方差（GMV）和确定性等价切线（CET）准则。结果表明，GMV投资组合在风险度量方面优于其他投资组合。此外，回测证据显示，包含绿色资产的投资组合在短期 horizons 上表现优于基准。研究结果对基金经理和政策制定者具有启示意义，因为绿色资产提供了宝贵的多元化收益，并进一步推动了可持续发展的目标。

articles.title_en: Assessing and comparing fixed-target forecasts of Arctic sea ice: Glide charts for feature-engineered linear regression and machine learning models
articles.title_cn: 评估与比较北极海冰的固定目标预测：特征工程线性回归与机器学习模型的滑翔图
articles.abstract_en: We use “glide charts” (plots of sequences of root mean squared forecast errors as the target date is approached) to evaluate and compare fixed-target forecasts of Arctic sea ice. We first use them to evaluate the simple feature-engineered linear regression (FELR) forecasts of Diebold and Göbel (2022), and to compare FELR forecasts to naive pure-trend benchmark forecasts. Then we introduce a much more sophisticated feature-engineered machine learning (FEML) model, and we use glide charts to evaluate FEML forecasts and compare them to a FELR benchmark. Our substantive results include the frequent appearance of predictability thresholds, which differ across months, meaning that accuracy initially fails to improve as the target date is approached but then increases progressively once a threshold lead time is crossed. Also, we find that FEML can improve appreciably over FELR when forecasting “turning point” months in the annual cycle at horizons of one to three months ahead.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用“滑翔图”（随着目标日期临近，均方根预测误差序列的绘图）来评估和比较北极海冰的固定目标预测。我们首先用它们来评估Diebold和Göbel（2022）的简单特征工程线性回归（FELR）预测，并将FELR预测与朴素的纯趋势基准预测进行比较。然后我们引入一个更为复杂的特征工程机器学习（FEML）模型，并使用滑翔图来评估FEML预测并将其与FELR基准进行比较。我们的实质性结果包括频繁出现的可预测性阈值，这些阈值在不同月份间有所不同，这意味着随着目标日期的临近，准确性最初不会提高，但一旦超过阈值提前期，准确性就会逐步提高。此外，我们发现，在预测年度周期中的“转折点”月份时，FEML在一至三个月的预测期内可以比FELR有显著改进。

articles.title_en: Electricity price spike clustering: A zero-inflated GARX approach
articles.title_cn: 电价尖峰聚类：一种零膨胀GARX方法
articles.abstract_en: Sudden dramatic rises in electricity prices, known as electricity “price spikes”, are ubiquitous in electricity spot markets worldwide. These price spikes often cluster. Energy retailers in many countries, including Australia, purchase electricity in an unregulated spot market and sell it to consumers at a heavily regulated price. As a result, the occurrence and clustering of spikes in the spot electricity price is particularly hazardous for retailers, and effective modelling and forecasting of these spikes is of foremost importance for effective risk management. This paper uses a data-dependent two-regime threshold autoregression to determine the electricity price spikes and proposes a zero-inflated generalized autoregression with exogenous covariates (ZIGARX) for modelling the time series count of price spikes. This model is shown to well capture the salient features of electricity price spikes, and can provide effective rolling probability forecasts of price spike occurrence. We apply the proposed approach to analyze the spot prices in four major regions in the Australian National Electricity Market (NEM) over the period April 2016 to February 2022. Results show that price spike clustering is captured very well using our model, and the persistence in price spike occurrence remains even after controlling for the relevant exogenous covariates. We also find that, in most of our sample period, the increasing use of renewable generation has mixed effects on the occurrence of price spikes.
articles.abstract_cn: 电价的突然急剧上涨，即所谓的电价“尖峰”，在世界各地的电力现货市场中普遍存在。这些价格尖峰往往呈现聚类现象。包括澳大利亚在内的许多国家的能源零售商，在不受监管的现货市场购买电力，并以受到严格监管的价格出售给消费者。因此，现货电价尖峰的发生和聚类对零售商而言尤其危险，而对这些尖峰的有效建模和预测对于有效的风险管理至关重要。本文采用数据依赖的两机制阈值自回归来确定电价尖峰，并提出了一种带有外生协变量的零膨胀广义自回归（ZIGARX）模型来对价格尖峰的时间序列计数进行建模。该模型被证明能够很好地捕捉电价尖峰的显著特征，并能提供有效的滚动概率预测。我们将所提出的方法应用于分析澳大利亚国家电力市场（NEM）四个主要地区在2016年四月至2022年二月期间的现货价格。结果表明，我们的模型很好地捕捉了价格尖峰的聚类现象，并且在控制相关外生协变量后，价格尖峰发生的持续性仍然存在。我们还发现，在我们样本期间的大部分时间里，可再生能源发电的增加对价格尖峰的发生具有混合效应。

articles.title_en: Green finance and clean taxes are the ways to curb carbon emissions: An OECD experience
articles.title_cn: 绿色金融与清洁税收是遏制碳排放的途径：来自OECD的经验
articles.abstract_en: The rising carbon dioxide emissions pose a significant threat to environmental sustainability. The attention, once primarily on production-based emissions, has recently shifted towards consumption-based carbon (CCO2) emissions. While much of the existing literature focuses on production-based impacts, the interplay between green finance, environmental taxes, and CCO2 emissions is yet to be comprehensively explored. To address this knowledge gap, our study investigates the dynamics of these variables across 21 OECD economies from 1990 to 2020, also considering trade activities and economic growth. We employ the second-generation unit root test and methodologies to manage cross-sectional dependence and slope heterogeneity, establishing cointegration among the variables of interest. Applying an innovative quantile regression method adapted for non-normal data distribution, our results highlight economic growth and imports as major drivers of CCO2 emissions, with exports, green finance, and environmental taxes serving as substantial mitigating forces. This pattern remains consistent across all quantiles. Our analysis reveals a unidirectional influence of trade on CCO2 emissions, with bidirectional causality observed between economic growth, green finance, environmental taxes, and CCO2 emissions. In light of our findings, we recommend fostering green finance and levying environmental taxes in industries with high pollution output as key strategies for advancing environmental sustainability.
